caps: Why are so many | *HINDU GODS BLUE?*
lines.tts: Why are so many Hindu gods blue?

caps: The answer is hiding | *IN THEIR NAMES.*
lines.tts: The answer is hiding in their names.
That's why he's also called Ghanshyaam: dark as a rain cloud.
Tulsidas sings of Shri Ram as dark as a blue lotus.

caps: And the Vishnu shloka | you hear at home?
*MEGHA VARNAM:* | the colour of a cloud.
lines.tts: And the Vishnu shloka you hear at home? Megha varnam: the colour of a cloud.

caps: So in paintings, | that dark became *BLUE.*
lines.tts: Dark as a monsoon sky. So in paintings, that dark became blue.
But here's the twist. Shiva isn't blue at all.

caps: You sing it | after every aarti.
lines.tts: Karpoor Gauram: white as camphor. You sing it after every aarti.

caps: from the poison | he held there
lines.tts: Only his throat is blue, from the poison he held there, to save the world.

caps: Your child will ask you | this one day.
lines.tts: Your child will ask you this one day. Now you know.
Did you know Shiva was white? Comment yes, or no!
